title: The Ultimate Treasure: Cartographer's Vault
description: With the complete Ancient Magnet assembled, the ultimate treasure location is revealed. Fish at the pyramid on the Big Island during sunset hours (17:00-19:59) using your Ancient Magnet. You'll need a rod with at least 300lb capacity to retrieve the legendary vault containing the cartographer's ultimate treasure.
fishingTip: Fish at the pyramid on the Big Island during sunset (17:00-19:59). You need a rod with at least 300lb capacity and your Ancient Magnet to retrieve the vault!

rewards.description: The legendary vault contains treasures beyond imagination and completes your archaeological expedition.
